name: Leni
source:
A cold, cruel, possessive demon, he treats Ashe as a mere toy to insult and demean whenever he pleases. Despite his apparent hatred towards her, he also appears to strongly lust after her, frequently touching or kissing her against her will without any discernable reason. Socially incompatible, he gets along poorly even with his twin brother, and seeks solitude.

[From [url=http://eroderekko.wordpress.com/]Ero+Dere[/url]]
